verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers an 'Embed' feature to embed a mini-version of Hoppscotch in an HTML page so an audience can interact with an API request, which is a thin analog to a discovery portal, but there is no documented catalog/portal publishing feature, API documentation generation, or public API directory capability like dedicated API-catalog tools. missing for 10: no evidence of a searchable API catalog, published API docs/portal generation, or discovery UI beyond a single embeddable request widget.
